opis: NIGHT in the vegetable garden from the reference picture: the FIRST SNOW is falling in big soft flakes, the beds and the fence turning white. At the round window of a hollow in a big tree at the side, the SQUIRREL looks out in her pyjamas, holding a candle, amazed, her nose against the glass; inside behind her a little shelf full of nuts. Dark blue sky, a warm glow from the window. Calm and magical.
